name: Efavirenz
toxicity: may cause liver toxicity at high doses or after chronic use
summary: Efavirenz is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Benzoxazine chemical class.

pharmacology.text: It is a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI) and works by blocking the function of reverse transcriptase.

uses.text: Efavirenz (EFV), sold under the brand names Sustiva among others, is an antiretroviral medication used to treat and prevent HIV/AIDS. It may be used for prevention after a needlestick injury or other potential exposure. It is sold both by itself and in combination as efavirenz/emtricitabine/tenofovir.
uses.recreational: Abuse of efavirenz by crushing and smoking the tablets for supposed hallucinogenic and dissociative effects has been reported in South Africa, where it is used in a mixture known as whoonga and nyaope. Researcher Hamilton Morris described efavirenz as "classically psychedelic."

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include rash, nausea, headache, feeling tired, and trouble sleeping.

summaryZh: 依法韋侖（英語：Efavirenz，簡稱EFV） 以Sustiva等品牌於市面販售，是一種用於治療和預防愛滋病的抗反轉錄病毒藥物。通常是建議與其他抗反轉錄病毒藥物一起使用。它也可用於針刺傷害或其他潛在暴露後的預防感染用途。此藥物既可單獨出售，也可以依法韋倫/恩曲他濱/替諾福韋複方劑的形式販售。此藥物透過口服方式給藥。
summaryZhHans: 依法韦仑（英语：Efavirenz，简称EFV） 以Sustiva等品牌于市面贩售，是一种用于治疗和预防艾滋病的抗反转录病毒药物。通常是建议与其他抗反转录病毒药物一起使用。它也可用于针刺伤害或其他潜在暴露后的预防感染用途。此药物既可单独出售，也可以依法韦伦/恩曲他滨/替诺福韦复方剂的形式贩售。此药物透过口服方式给药。
